The smallest number of integer squares that sum to 7 is four ($7 = 2^2 + 1^2 + 1^2 + 1^2$). This requires $n-1=4$, so $n=5$.

The previous notes confirm this result via construction.

I will submit the finding based on this rigorous interpretation.
